cd "$(dirname "$0")"
context=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$context"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
interpreter=/usr/bin/python3
[ -x "$interpreter" ] || interpreter=$(command -v python3 || true)
[ -n "$interpreter" ] || { echo 'build.sh needs python3 on PATH: the interpreter setup used is gone' >&2; exit 1; }
"$interpreter" -I -S -c 'import hashlib, pathlib, sys; sys.exit(0 if hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sys.argv[2] else "build context helper differs from setup; refusing rebuild")' build_context.py fcede03ea040944972f2b62abb3750e79e098f1fc5d4bef2e13f6051fe73c9d2

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile

destination = Path(sys.argv[1])
version, agent_hash, cultivate_hash = sys.argv[4:7]
inputs = (("mimir_agent", Path(sys.argv[2]), agent_hash),
          ("mimir_cultivate", Path(sys.argv[3]), cultivate_hash))
s6 = ("mimir/type", "mimir/run", "watchdog/type", "watchdog/run",
      "worklink-execd/type", "worklink-execd/run", "worklink-execd/dependencies.d/base",
      "user/contents.d/mimir", "user/contents.d/watchdog", "user/contents.d/worklink-execd",
      "worklink-opencode/type", "worklink-opencode/run", "worklink-opencode/dependencies.d/base",
      "user/contents.d/worklink-opencode")
scripts = ("base.sh", "users.sh", "executor.sh", "controller.sh", "bootstrap.sh",
           "service.sh", "verify_wheels.py", "worklink-opencode-service",
           "worklink-daemon-gate", "worklink-opencode-login")
if not version or destination.exists() and any(destination.iterdir()):
    raise SystemExit("invalid Docker context destination or version")
opened = {}
try:
    for name, path, digest in inputs:
        if (not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink() or
                not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest) or
                not re.fullmatch(re.escape(name) + "-" + re.escape(version) + r"-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.whl", path.name) or
                hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest):
            raise ValueError("wheel identity mismatch: " + name)
        opened[name] = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
    resources = [("mimir_agent", "mimir/docker_context/Dockerfile", "Dockerfile")]
    resources += [("mimir_agent", "mimir/docker_context/deploy/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/" + name,
                   "deploy/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/" + name) for name in s6]
    resources += [("mimir_cultivate", "mimir_cultivate/docker/" + name,
                   "plugins/cultivate/mimir_cultivate/docker/" + name) for name in scripts]
    for package, member, _ in resources:
        info = opened[package].getinfo(member)
        if info.is_dir() or (info.external_attr >> 16) & 0o170000 == 0o120000:
            raise ValueError("unsafe Docker context resource: " + member)
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for package, member, target in resources:
        output = destination / target
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output.write_bytes(opened[package].read(member))
        output.chmod((opened[package].getinfo(member).external_attr >> 16) & 0o777)
    wheels = destination / "plugins/cultivate/mimir_cultivate/docker/wheels"
    wheels.mkdir()
    for _, path, _ in inputs:
        shutil.copyfile(path, wheels / path.name)
finally:
    for archive in opened.values():
        archive.close()

provision.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import uuid
import yaml
from mimir.identities_populator import add_identity_alias, issue_web_key
from mimir.identities import hash_web_key
from mimir.plugins.skills import (resolve_skill, selected_skills, install_skill, skill_state, skill_inventory,
                                   previous_skill_inventories, upgrade_command)
from mimir.skill_install import _file_hashes
from mimir_cultivate.setup import _provision_saga, _provision_worklink

m = json.loads(Path('/opt/cultivate-manifest.json').read_text())
changed = False
home = Path('/home/mimir/agent')
os.environ['HOME'] = '/home/mimir'
os.environ['XDG_CACHE_HOME'] = '/home/mimir/.cache'
changed = _provision_saga(home, m['saga_model_spec'], m['embedding'], m['reembed'],
                          previous_spec=m.get('previous_saga_model_spec'))
repo = Path('/workspace') / m['slug'].split('/')[1]
origin = 'https://github.com/' + m['slug'] + '.git'
# Persist only the helper program, never the token. Git runs it for future
# fetch/push too; the credential is read at runtime from the process environment.
helper = '!f() { if [ "$1" = get ]; then printf "%s\\n" "username=x-access-token" "password=$GITHUB_TOKEN"; fi; }; f'
git_auth = ['git', '-c', 'credential.helper=', '-c', 'credential.https://github.com.helper=' + helper]
if not (repo / '.git').is_dir():
    subprocess.run(git_auth + ['clone', '--branch', m['branch'], origin, str(repo)],
                   capture_output=True, check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'config', '--local', 'credential.helper', ''],
               capture_output=True, check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'config', '--local', 'credential.https://github.com.helper', helper],
               capture_output=True, check=True)
result = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'config', '--local', '--get', 'remote.origin.url'],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
if result.stdout.strip() != origin:
    raise RuntimeError('existing checkout origin disagrees with target; refuse to bind')
# Use the checkout's persisted helper, exactly as the agent will. Never print
# git output: remote errors can reflect credentials. A dry run creates no ref.
probe = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repo), 'push', '--dry-run', 'origin',
                        'HEAD:refs/heads/cultivate-setup-probe-' + uuid.uuid4().hex],
                       capture_output=True, check=False)
if probe.returncode:
    # Classify captured bytes locally; never relay git's credential-bearing output.
    auth_failure = re.search(
        rb'The requested URL returned error: (?:401|403)(?![0-9])|'
        rb'Authentication failed|Permission to .+ denied|could not read Username',
        probe.stderr, re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    marker = 'CULTIVATE_PUSH_PROBE_FAILED' if auth_failure else 'CULTIVATE_PUSH_PROBE_UNREACHABLE'
    print(marker, flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(1)
inventory = home / 'repositories.yaml'
config = yaml.safe_load(inventory.read_text()) if inventory.exists() else {}
config = config or {}
base = Path('/workspace/worklink/base') / repo.name
entry = {'slug': m['slug'], 'root': str(repo), 'mode': 'rw', 'origin': origin,
           'base_branch': m['branch'], 'test_command': m['test'], 'review_tests': m['review_tests'],
           'auto_review': m.get('auto_review', 'all'),
           'worklink_gate': m.get('worklink_gate', 'local'), 'quick_gate_command': m.get('quick_gate_command'),
           'worklink_base': str(base)}
rows = config.setdefault('repositories', [])
old = next((r for r in rows if r.get('slug') == m['slug']), None)
# Back-fill only fields absent from an otherwise identical legacy declaration.
# Explicit values (including the gate mode) are never silently replaced.
optional = {'worklink_base', 'review_tests', 'auto_review', 'worklink_gate', 'quick_gate_command'}
if old is not None and set(entry) - set(old) <= optional and all(old[k] == entry[k] for k in old.keys() & entry.keys()):
    missing = {k: v for k, v in entry.items() if k not in old}
    old.update(missing)
    changed = bool(missing) or changed
# Compare and override only setup-owned fields; operator-only policy survives
# both forced reconciliation and subsequent ordinary/idempotent setup runs.
differs = old is not None and any(k not in old or old[k] != v for k, v in entry.items())
if differs and not m.get('force', False):
    raise RuntimeError('existing repository declaration differs; reconcile manually')
if differs:
    old.update(entry)
    changed = True
if old is None:
    rows.append(entry)
    changed = True
roots = config.setdefault('allowed_roots', [])
for path in ('/workspace/pr-leases', '/workspace/worklink'):
    if not any(r.get('root') == path for r in roots):
        roots.append({'root': path, 'mode': 'rw'})
        changed = True
text = yaml.safe_dump(config, sort_keys=False)
if not inventory.exists() or inventory.read_text() != text:
    inventory.write_text(text)
    changed = True
changed = _provision_worklink(home, entry, base=base,
                            checkout=repo, git_auth=git_auth, force=m.get('force', False),
                            toolchain=m.get('toolchain'),
                            tracker=m.get('tracker_config'),
                            previous_tracker=m.get('previous_tracker_config')) or changed
skills = []
for name in ('github-poller', 'github-ci-watch', 'github', 'review') + (('tracker-poller',) if m.get('trackers') else ()):
    skill = resolve_skill('cultivate:' + name, set())
    if skill is None:
        raise RuntimeError('missing optional Cultivate skill: ' + name)
    skills.append((skill, skill_state(home, skill)))
# Default skills are seeded by the selected plugin, not by setup. Only reconcile
# trees already present in this deployment; never install an unselected default.
for skill in selected_skills():
    if skill.candidate.name == 'cultivate' and skill.default:
        state = skill_state(home, skill)
        if state != 'not installed':
            skills.append((skill, state))
# Refuse before changing any skill, so a modified tree cannot leave a partial upgrade.
for skill, state in skills:
    if state == 'modified' and not m.get('force', False):
        print('CULTIVATE_SKILL_MODIFIED:' + skill.name, flush=True)
        raise RuntimeError('modified Cultivate skill ' + skill.label +
                           '; reconcile it or run ' + upgrade_command(skill) +
                           ' (or rerun setup with --force to back up and restore it)')
# Resolve all display metadata before the first install/restore. A metadata
# error must not interrupt the loop after earlier skills have been replaced.
upgrades = {}
for skill, state in skills:
    if state in ('upgrade available', 'modified'):
        releases = previous_skill_inventories(skill)
        old_release = 'modified'
        if state == 'upgrade available':
            # This walker is only for display, not upgrade authorization. Its
            # exclusions can differ from skill_state's strict tree comparison.
            actual = _file_hashes(home / 'skills' / skill.dirname)
            old_release = next((version for version, files in releases.items()
                                if files == actual), 'recorded release')
        inventory = skill_inventory(skill)
        new_release = next((version for version, files in releases.items()
                            if files == inventory), 'packaged')
        upgrades[skill.name] = (old_release, new_release)
for skill, state in skills:
    if state == 'not installed':
        install_skill(home, skill)
        changed = True
    elif state in ('upgrade available', 'modified'):
        old_release, new_release = upgrades[skill.name]
        install_skill(home, skill, restore=True)
        print('Upgraded skill ' + skill.label + ' (' + old_release + ' -> ' + new_release + ')')
        changed = True
identities = home / 'state' / 'identities.yaml'
doc = yaml.safe_load(identities.read_text()) if identities.exists() else {}
person = next((p for p in (doc or {}).get('people', []) if p.get('canonical') == m['owner']), None)
if person is not None and not {'user', 'admin'}.issubset(set(person.get('access', {}).get('roles', []))):
    raise RuntimeError('owner exists without admin+user roles; reconcile explicitly')
if person is None:
    add_identity_alias(home, m['owner'], 'email:' + m['email'], m['display'])
    changed = True
key_file = home / 'owner-web-key'
if key_file.is_symlink():
    raise RuntimeError('owner web key path must not be a symlink')
if key_file.exists() and not m['rotate']:
    key_file.chmod(0o600)
    if person is None or hash_web_key(key_file.read_text().strip()) not in person.get('aliases', []):
        raise RuntimeError('owner web-key file no longer matches identities; rotate explicitly')
else:
    from mimir.identities_populator import _default_web_key
    import os
    raw = _default_web_key()
    fd = os.open(key_file, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, 'w') as output:
        output.write(raw + '\n')
    issue_web_key(home, m['owner'], roles=['user', 'admin'] if person is None else None,
                  label='cultivate-setup', rotate=m['rotate'], key_factory=lambda: raw)
    changed = True
print('SETUP_CHANGED=' + ('1' if changed else '0'))

# Generated by `mimir scaffold-docker`. THIS FILE IS REGENERATED IN
# FULL on every run — do NOT edit it in place; your changes WILL be
# lost the next time `mimir scaffold-docker` runs.
#
# To customize the build for this deployment, add a separate layer
# (e.g. ``Dockerfile.custom``) and reference it from compose.yml, or
# author a per-skill ``dockerfile.fragment`` under
# ``<home>/skills/<name>/`` — those get stitched into the
# sentinel-marked block below on each regeneration.
#
# Build: docker compose build --build-arg USER_UID=$(id -u)
# Run:   docker compose up -d

ARG BASE_IMAGE=public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.11-slim-trixie
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}

# Base system tooling — same set mimirbot has been running with since
# 2026-05: git for the source clone + agent dev loop, gh for PR
# creation, build-essential for any C extensions, ca-certificates for
# HTTPS clones, poppler-utils for PDF ingest, Node 22 (needed for
# optional coding tools plus mermaid-cli), jq for JSONL log parsing
# across many skill bodies + the introspection recipes.
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        git \
        tini \
        curl \
        ca-certificates \
        build-essential \
        gnupg \
        tmux \
        poppler-utils \
        jq \
        ripgrep \
 && curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
        | dd of=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
 && chmod go+r /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
 && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list \
 && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh nodejs \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

ENV NODE_VERSION=22
ENV MIMIR_FACTORY_ENTRYPOINT=/opt/mimir-opencode/lib/node_modules/feature-factory/bin/factory.js
ENV PATH="/opt/mimir-opencode/bin:${PATH}"
ARG MIMIR_ENABLE_OPENCODE=0
ARG FACTORY_VERSION=0.14.1
COPY .mimir-scaffold/cultivate-docker/ /opt/cultivate-docker/
RUN NODE_VERSION="$NODE_VERSION" MIMIR_ENABLE_OPENCODE="$MIMIR_ENABLE_OPENCODE" FACTORY_VERSION="$FACTORY_VERSION" sh /opt/cultivate-docker/base.sh

# Pinned mermaid CLI (used by mermaid-diagrams skill).
RUN npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.16.0



# uv handles dep resolution + virtualenv inside the workspace clone.
RUN curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh \
 && mv /root/.local/bin/uv /usr/local/bin/uv \
 && mv /root/.local/bin/uvx /usr/local/bin/uvx



# ===== BEGIN mimir-scaffold-docker: skill fragments =====
# Auto-generated from <home>/skills/*/dockerfile.fragment.
# Each skill that ships a fragment contributes one block below.
# Re-run `mimir scaffold-docker` to refresh after installing /
# uninstalling skills.
# (no skills installed yet ship a dockerfile.fragment)
# ===== END mimir-scaffold-docker: skill fragments =====



# Non-root user. Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions
# (which mimir's permission_mode="bypassPermissions" maps to) when
# the process is uid 0. Match USER_UID to your host UID at build time:
#   docker compose build --build-arg USER_UID=$(id -u)
ARG USER_UID=1001
ARG USER_GID=1001
# Defensive: some skill fragments (notably 1Password's apt package)
# install service users that may grab UID 1000 before this layer
# runs. If a non-mimir user occupies our target UID/GID, delete it
# so the explicit useradd below succeeds. Surfaced in the
# muninn-mimir migration (mimir-repo issue #332).
RUN existing_uid_user=$(getent passwd "${USER_UID}" | cut -d: -f1) \
 && if [ -n "$existing_uid_user" ] && [ "$existing_uid_user" != "mimir" ]; then \
        echo "[Dockerfile] removing user $existing_uid_user at UID ${USER_UID} to free the slot for mimir"; \
        userdel "$existing_uid_user" \
            || echo "[Dockerfile] WARNING: userdel $existing_uid_user failed — subsequent useradd may also fail"; \
    fi \
 && existing_gid_group=$(getent group "${USER_GID}" | cut -d: -f1) \
 && if [ -n "$existing_gid_group" ] && [ "$existing_gid_group" != "mimir" ]; then \
        echo "[Dockerfile] removing group $existing_gid_group at GID ${USER_GID} to free the slot"; \
        groupdel "$existing_gid_group" \
            || echo "[Dockerfile] WARNING: groupdel $existing_gid_group failed — subsequent groupadd may also fail"; \
    fi
RUN sh /opt/cultivate-docker/users.sh \
 && mkdir -p /workspace /mimir-home \
 && chown -R mimir:mimir /workspace /mimir-home

# (OpenCode config bootstrapped at runtime when coding is enabled)

WORKDIR /workspace

# ENV PATH uses Docker's standard variable-substitution grammar
# (``${VAR}``) so the base image's PATH propagates. A double-braced
# form like ``$ + { + {PATH} + } + }`` is NOT valid Docker syntax;
# an earlier draft of this template shipped that token literally and
# the resulting container had a broken PATH. The regression test in
# tests/test_scaffold_docker.py asserts this stays clean.
ENV MIMIR_HOME=/mimir-home \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.uv-cache \
    PATH=/usr/local/bin:${PATH}

USER root
ARG MIMIR_GIT_REF
ARG MIMIR_CONTROLLER_COMMIT
ARG MIMIR_EXECUTOR_COMMIT
ARG MIMIR_GIT_URL=https://github.com/SquashMerge/mimir.git
ARG MIMIR_EXTRAS=anthropic,discord,slack,mcp
RUN test "$MIMIR_EXECUTOR_COMMIT" = "$MIMIR_CONTROLLER_COMMIT" && git check-ref-format "$MIMIR_GIT_REF"
RUN MIMIR_GIT_REF="$MIMIR_GIT_REF" MIMIR_EXECUTOR_COMMIT="$MIMIR_EXECUTOR_COMMIT" MIMIR_GIT_URL="$MIMIR_GIT_URL" MIMIR_EXTRAS="$MIMIR_EXTRAS" sh /opt/cultivate-docker/executor.sh

EXPOSE 8080

COPY start.sh /usr/local/bin/start.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/start.sh

USER mimir

# Selected plugin services require an independent, root-owned supervisor.
USER root
ARG S6_OVERLAY_VERSION=3.2.0.2
ARG TARGETARCH
RUN set -eu; \
    case "${TARGETARCH:-amd64}" in \
        amd64) S6_ARCH=x86_64 ;; \
        arm64) S6_ARCH=aarch64 ;; \
        *) echo >&2 "unsupported s6 architecture: ${TARGETARCH}"; exit 2 ;; \
    esac; \
    base="https://github.com/just-containers/s6-overlay/releases/download/v${S6_OVERLAY_VERSION}"; \
    curl -fsSL "${base}/s6-overlay-noarch.tar.xz" -o /tmp/s6-noarch.tar.xz; \
    curl -fsSL "${base}/s6-overlay-${S6_ARCH}.tar.xz" -o /tmp/s6-arch.tar.xz; \
    tar -C / -Jxpf /tmp/s6-noarch.tar.xz; \
    tar -C / -Jxpf /tmp/s6-arch.tar.xz; \
    rm -f /tmp/s6-noarch.tar.xz /tmp/s6-arch.tar.xz

USER root
COPY .mimir-scaffold/s6-rc.d/ /etc/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/
RUN sh /opt/cultivate-docker/service.sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/init"]

scaffold-pypi.text:
# Generated by `mimir scaffold-docker --mode pypi`. THIS FILE IS
# REGENERATED IN FULL on every run — do NOT edit it in place; your
# changes WILL be lost the next time `mimir scaffold-docker` runs.
#
# Mode: pypi. mimir-agent installs from PyPI into a user-owned venv
# at image-build time; the pending-update flow (operator-approved
# upgrade via the ``request_mimir_update`` tool) does
# ``pip install --upgrade`` against that venv on next restart.
#
# Build: docker compose build --build-arg USER_UID=$(id -u)
# Run:   docker compose up -d

ARG BASE_IMAGE=public.ecr.aws/docker/library/python:3.11-slim-trixie
FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}

# Base system tooling — git for any local commits the agent makes,
# gh for PR / issue automation, build-essential for C extensions
# pulled by deps, poppler-utils + jq because skill bodies use them,
# Node 22 for optional coding tools + mermaid CLI.
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        git \
        tini \
        curl \
        ca-certificates \
        build-essential \
        gnupg \
        tmux \
        poppler-utils \
        jq \
        ripgrep \
 && curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
        | dd of=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
 && chmod go+r /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
 && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list \
 && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh nodejs \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Pinned mermaid CLI (used by mermaid-diagrams skill).
RUN npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.16.0



# (No ``uv`` install — PyPI mode uses pip directly against a
# user-owned venv. Saves ~30 MB of image and one moving part.)

# ===== BEGIN mimir-scaffold-docker: skill fragments =====
# Auto-generated from <home>/skills/*/dockerfile.fragment.
# Each skill that ships a fragment contributes one block below.
# Re-run `mimir scaffold-docker` to refresh after installing /
# uninstalling skills.
# (no skills installed yet ship a dockerfile.fragment)
# ===== END mimir-scaffold-docker: skill fragments =====

# Non-root user. Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions
# when uid 0; the bind-mounted ``/mimir-home`` also needs to match
# the host UID so the operator can read/edit agent state without
# sudo. ``docker compose build --build-arg USER_UID=$(id -u)``.
ARG USER_UID=1000
ARG USER_GID=1000
# Defensive: some skill fragments (notably 1Password's apt package)
# install service users that may grab UID 1000 before this layer
# runs. If a non-mimir user occupies our target UID/GID, delete it
# so the explicit useradd below succeeds. Surfaced in the
# muninn-mimir migration (mimir-repo issue #332).
RUN existing_uid_user=$(getent passwd "${USER_UID}" | cut -d: -f1) \
 && if [ -n "$existing_uid_user" ] && [ "$existing_uid_user" != "mimir" ]; then \
        echo "[Dockerfile] removing user $existing_uid_user at UID ${USER_UID} to free the slot for mimir"; \
        userdel "$existing_uid_user" \
            || echo "[Dockerfile] WARNING: userdel $existing_uid_user failed — subsequent useradd may also fail"; \
    fi \
 && existing_gid_group=$(getent group "${USER_GID}" | cut -d: -f1) \
 && if [ -n "$existing_gid_group" ] && [ "$existing_gid_group" != "mimir" ]; then \
        echo "[Dockerfile] removing group $existing_gid_group at GID ${USER_GID} to free the slot"; \
        groupdel "$existing_gid_group" \
            || echo "[Dockerfile] WARNING: groupdel $existing_gid_group failed — subsequent groupadd may also fail"; \
    fi
RUN groupadd --gid "${USER_GID}" mimir \
 && useradd --uid "${USER_UID}" --gid "${USER_GID}" --create-home --shell /bin/bash mimir \
 && mkdir -p /mimir-home \
 && chown -R mimir:mimir /mimir-home

# (OpenCode config bootstrapped at runtime when coding is enabled)

USER mimir
WORKDIR /home/mimir

# User-owned venv. The pending-update flag flow runs
# ``pip install --upgrade mimir-agent`` against THIS venv at next
# restart, then ``os.execv``'s onto the new code. User ownership
# is what makes that work without root.
ENV VIRTUAL_ENV=/home/mimir/venv
RUN python3 -m venv "$VIRTUAL_ENV"
ENV PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"

# Install mimir-agent from PyPI. Extras default to the scaffold-time
# choice (--extras flag); operators can override at build time via:
#
#   docker build --build-arg MIMIR_EXTRAS=anthropic,discord .
#
# Available extras (mimir-agent pyproject):
#   anthropic, claude-code, openai, codex-plus    (model providers)
#   discord, slack                   (bridges)
#   mcp                              (Model Context Protocol)
#
# Set MIMIR_ENABLE_CLAUDE_CODE=1 below to install the Claude Code model adapter.
# Its CLI is an operator-provided runtime dependency and is not bundled.
ARG MIMIR_EXTRAS="anthropic,discord,slack,mcp"
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip \
 && pip install --no-cache-dir "mimir-agent[${MIMIR_EXTRAS}]"

# Optional: install the Claude Code model-provider adapter.
ARG MIMIR_ENABLE_CLAUDE_CODE=0
RUN if [ "$MIMIR_ENABLE_CLAUDE_CODE" = "1" ]; then \
        pip install --no-cache-dir "mimir-agent[claude-code]" ; \
    fi

# Pre-warm the fastembed model cache so the first request doesn't
# pay the ~80MB download. Skipped silently if offline at build time.
RUN python -c "from fastembed import TextEmbedding; TextEmbedding(model_name='BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5')" || true

ENV MIMIR_HOME=/mimir-home

EXPOSE 8080

COPY --chown=mimir:mimir start.sh /usr/local/bin/start.sh
# Source file must be executable in the repo (committed +x); we
# can't chmod after copying since USER mimir doesn't own /usr/local/bin.

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/tini", "--", "/usr/local/bin/start.sh"]
